agenda_text:
AGENDA
  SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  HAPPY NEW YEAR!
  Wednesday, January 16, 2019
  10:00 AM

Approval of Minutes from the November 21, 2018 meeting (December meeting was dark).

1.  Nutrition Program  Monthly Update

2.  Guest Speaker  None

3.  Bingo Report  Bingo Representative will present financials.

4.  Meals on Wheels  Monthly Update

5.  Account Balance Update  Monthly Update

6.  Fee Schedule for Use of Facilities  Monthly Update

7.  Community Senior Services  Monthly Update

8.  Mt. SAC Classes  Monthly Update

9.  Upcoming Events  -Monday, January 21st – Center closed in observance of
  Martin Luther King Jr. Day
  -Thursday, February 14th – Special City Sponsored Lunch
  (Valentine’s Day theme), 11:30 AM
  -Monday, February 18th – Center closed in observance of
  Presidents’ Day

10.  SAC Shirts

11.  Facilities Report  Monthly Update

12.  Public Comments  This is the time set aside for anyone wishing to address the
  Senior Advisory Committee on items not listed on the agenda.

13.  Adjournment of Meeting  The next meeting will be Wednesday, February 20, 2019 at
  10:00 AM.
